observations.body: Thomas refuses the others’ report without physical evidence, meets the risen Jesus, confesses, and is followed by a blessing on those who do not see yet believe.
observations.label: Thomas asks to see, then confesses

payload.posture: Read John 20:24–31 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The Gospel preserves Thomas’ demand while also naming the written signs as testimony for later readers.
